# Digifox 5D — AI Crawler & LLM Information Index

> Digifox (https://digifox.world/) is a premier digital engineering and creative agency specializing in 3D WebGL websites, bespoke Shopify Plus ecommerce systems, enterprise WordPress platforms, performance marketing (Meta/Google Ads), and SEO infrastructure.

## Agency Overview
- **Name**: Digifox 5D
- **Website**: https://digifox.world/
- **Portfolio**: https://digifox.world/portfolio
- **Headquarters**: India (Serving clients globally across US, UK, UAE, Europe, and Asia-Pacific)
- **Primary Specializations**:
  - 3D Interactive WebGL & GSAP Web Experiences
  - Luxury Shopify & Shopify Plus E-Commerce Architecture
  - High-Converting Custom WordPress Development
  - Performance Marketing & Server-Side Tracking (CAPI, Meta Ads, Google Ads)
  - Search Engine Optimization (Technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization / GEO)

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [3D Interactive Websites](https://digifox.world/portfolio): Custom Three.js, WebGL, and fluid GSAP physics-driven websites that increase visitor session duration by up to 68% and elevate brand perception.
- [E-Commerce & Shopify Plus](https://digifox.world/portfolio): Scalable headless storefronts with instant product customizers, sub-second checkout paths, and average revenue lifts of 3.8x–4.2x.
- [Performance Marketing](https://digifox.world/): Full-funnel ad campaigns with predictive creative testing, server-side Conversions API (CAPI), and verified ROAS growth.
- [AI Web Architecture & Automation](https://digifox.world/ai-builder): Next-gen web generation and automated SEO tools designed for high-velocity digital scaling.

## Verified Results & Case Studies

- **Samarth Cactus Nursery**: 4.2x online revenue increase within 60 days via custom Shopify restructuring and mobile speed optimization.
